packages.name: jpeg-js
packages.comment: Vendored at vendor/jpeg-js/lib/decoder.js (decoder only) so the wallpaper manager can read the colours of a JPEG wallpaper. The host offers plugins no image decoding, and the UI iframe cannot decode one either: it is a sandboxed opaque origin, and the theme-asset route sends Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin with no CORS header, so a canvas read would both fail to load and be tainted. Only the decoder is bundled; the encoder is not shipped.
